index_binding: Indexes are the 53-segment snapshot identified by spec_sha256; join by scene and exact narration after any root edits. Candidate windows are alternatives, not an instruction to duplicate footage already used as original audio.

method_actual.frames_generated: All six complete sources every 8 seconds; all eight proposed raw windows every 1 and 0.25 seconds; additional priority windows every 0.25 seconds; additional narration/trophy windows every 0.5 seconds.
method_actual.human_review: Selected sheets were actually viewed as paired original and exact fixed-centre crop; selected means no claim that all generated sheets or every frame of full sources was reviewed. Evidence paths are listed per decision.
method_actual.timestamp_accuracy: Sheet timestamps are FPS-filter sampling centres; alignment may differ by a source frame. Recommended edit bounds are approximate visual windows and must align with actual source cuts and audio word boundaries.
method_actual.quality_claim: Suitable for a full-canvas promotional/history montage with specified lateral crop losses; not certified as complete-ball-path match replay.
method_actual.audio: No silence, lack-of-English, or transcript completeness inferred from frames. Every proposed narration background requires audio-team interval audit.
method_actual.implementation: Native video segment cut_segment with fit=crop,cx=0.5,track=false,crop_zoom=1; no template/CSS/font/branding change.

global_tradeoffs: 固定中心全铺满优先。横向球路/双人分立自然会切边；有瞬间越界不否决整源，选实际中心动作与脸部反应，旁白不说完整末球复盘。
所有比赛原生计分牌位于左下，被中心crop切部分姓名/比分。最终必须用栏目既有计分牌补丁方式，核真值；不要自创比分牌模板。
2005有原源4:3归档左右黑柱；中心crop消除黑柱，但历史画质仍较低，不能宣称原生历史4K。
本审查不是音频通行证，也不是最终成片logo/字幕/品牌总检；最终export应由root按原栏目要求核。
